text:
```yaml
name: Stale PRs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # run daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Mark stale pull requests
        uses: actions/stale@v9
        with:
          days-before-pr-stale: 15
          days-before-pr-close: 7
          stale-pr-message: |
            This pull request has been marked as stale because it has had no activity for 15 days.
            If you still want to keep it open, please add a comment or remove the stale label.
          close-pr-message: |
            This pull request has been closed because it remained stale for 7 days with no activity.
          stale-pr-label: stale
          exempt-pr-labels: pinned,work-in-progress,on-hold
          days-before-issue-stale: -1
          days-before-issue-close: -1
```
